title: JSON Schema lab
description: Validate example documents against a JSON Schema, see which expectations hold and why, and fix the schema.
needs: an object with a schema (a JSON Schema, draft 2020-12) and examples ([{ id, value, outcome: "pass" | "fail" }], at least one)

tools.name: setSchema
tools.description: Replace the whole schema with a JSON value.

tools.name: patchSchema
tools.description: Set the value at a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) in the schema, e.g. "/properties/age/minimum". The value is JSON as itself (an object, not its JSON text). The parent must exist (set a missing object whole, e.g. /properties/age to {"type": "integer"}); in an array use an index or "-" to append; "" replaces the whole schema.

tools.name: removeFromSchema
tools.description: Remove the value at a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) in the schema, e.g. "/properties/age" or "/required/1".

tools.name: addExample
tools.description: Add an example document; outcome is pass (should be valid) or fail (should be invalid). It gets the next free id (e1, e2, …).

tools.name: reorderExamples
tools.description: Move an example to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: setExpectation
tools.description: Say whether an example should be valid (pass) or invalid (fail).

tools.name: validation
tools.description: The schema's compile error if any, and for every example: expected outcome, whether it is valid, its status (pass, fail, or invalid when it can't run) and its error count.

tools.name: errorsFor
tools.description: The validation errors of one example: instancePath, keyword and message for each.
